mode.title: How should this garage door work?
mode.managedDesc: Pick the relay that triggers your door and the sensor that detects it is closed. The app operates the door and tracks its state itself.
mode.flowDesc: Your own Advanced Flows respond to open/close requests, operate the hardware and report the door state back. Maximum control.
mode.gateDesc: For shared entrance gates that open on a pulse and close again by themselves. No sensors: the app animates the cycle on timers, and every trigger simply means "open / stay open".

gate.hint: These only animate the tile — the gate itself keeps its own timing. Honest values mirror reality; short values (for example 3 / 3 / 1) bring the tile back to Closed within seconds, so the gate can immediately be triggered again — also from Apple Home, whose garage tile only accepts a new Open once it shows Closed.

config.controlHint: Usually the relay wired to your garage opener (for example a Shelly). Configure the relay itself to switch off automatically (momentary / auto-off) — this app only switches it on.
config.closed: Which sensor detects that the door is fully closed?
config.closedMeaning: The door is fully closed when this sensor reports:
config.open: Which sensor detects that the door is fully open? (optional)
config.openMeaning: The door is fully open when this sensor reports:
config.travelHint: Time your door and add 10–20% margin. Example: the door takes ~15 seconds, so enter 18.

request.open: Open requested — waiting for a Flow to report the actual state.
request.close: Close requested — waiting for a Flow to report the actual state.
request.already_open: The garage door is already open.
request.already_closed: The garage door is already closed.
request.already_moving: The garage door is already moving — wait until it finishes.
request.sensor_conflict: Both sensors report an endpoint at the same time — check the sensor configuration.
request.gate_auto_close: This gate closes by itself — it can only be opened.
request.nobody_home: Opening is blocked because nobody is home.
request.not_configured: Managed mode is not configured — use 'Repair' on this device to select your relay and sensors.
request.control_failed: The control device could not be switched — check that it is available.

warning.sensor_conflict: Both sensors report an endpoint at the same time. Check the sensors and their 'closed/open when' settings.
warning.not_reached_open: The door did not reach the open position within the expected travel time.
warning.not_reached_closed: The door did not reach the closed position within the expected travel time.
warning.not_configured: Managed mode is not configured. Use 'Repair' on this device to select your relay and sensors.
warning.missing_device: A configured device was removed or cannot be found. Use 'Repair' on this device to fix the configuration.
